column_description: TEXT. Unique serial number identifier for scanning equipment. PK = Equipment(EquipRegistry). Example: SN20065.
TEXT. Type classification of scanning equipment. Example: LiDAR scanner, precise 3D measurement technology.
TEXT. Model designation of scanning equipment. Example: Model-669.
DATE. Date of last equipment calibration or maintenance. Examprle: 2024-11-01.
TEXT. Current operational condition of equipment. Excellent condition, optimal performance guaranteed.
TEXT. Battery charge level as percentage. Example: 62% battery, extended operation available.
TEXT. Transportation speed for equipment delivery. Example: 85 km/h.
TEXT. Area coverage rate during scanning. Example: 12 m²/hr.
TEXT. Point cloud generation efficiency. Example: 62000 pts/min.
TEXT. Cost efficiency per unit area. Example: 45 USD/m².
TEXT. Accuracy improvement over scanning time. Example: 3 mm/hr.
TEXT. Equipment power consumption rate. Example: 125 W/hr.
TEXT. Battery consumption rate during operation. Example: 8%/hr.
TEXT. Storage space consumption during scanning. Example: 2.8 GB/hr.
